action: Deliver the written buyer profile analysis to Rick Tanner for the Hawkins auto mall disposition RFP. This is a structured document covering: (1) identified buyer pool segments — delivery logistics operators, EV fleet services, light industrial converters, mixed-use adaptive reuse developers — with specific companies active in the Millfield corridor; (2) price expectation range by buyer type, accounting for the current spending index of 25 and 50% unemployment; (3) deal structure preferences by buyer type (all-cash distressed buyers vs. financed adaptive reuse developers); (4) a recommended marketing strategy for the formal RFP. The document positions me as the agent who has already done the buyer-side work, which is what the disposition committee needs to see. I send it by Thursday. I follow up Friday with a brief call to Rick confirming receipt and asking whether the committee meeting has been scheduled.
